name: Mecury Commercial Electronics
old_description: Our Advanced Concepts Group brings experts in early, so we know what’s possible and what isn’t, before missions even ask.
about:
Mercury Commercial Electronics, operating as Mercury Systems, is headquartered in Hudson, New Hampshire. The company operates a 50,000-square-foot manufacturing facility on its Phoenix campus, which opened recently to expand production capacity for aerospace and defense missions.

Mercury designs and manufactures advanced electronics for signal and data processing, including Direct RF multi-chip modules, SpaceVPX processing boards, rugged Direct RF subsystems, and broadband MMIC devices. Its capabilities span chip-scale design, open architectures, and model-based systems engineering (MBSE), supporting applications from electronic warfare and radar to onboard AI and space-qualified microelectronics. The company reports supporting over 75 spacecraft across all orbits, including every Mars mission over the past 20 years.

The company serves the aerospace, defense, and space sectors, with customers including missile defense programs, electronic warfare systems, and emerging quantum-resistant security initiatives. Its technologies are deployed across land, sea, air, and space domains, and it collaborates with industry partners to integrate early-stage innovations into operational systems.

Mercury states that its differentiation lies in pushing the limits of data and signal processing to make once-impossible missions a reality. Its Advanced Concepts Group engages early to shape commercial technology into operational advantage, and the company emphasizes collaboration with industry leaders to keep customers equipped with the latest innovations.
